about: Cranbrook is a city in the East Kootenay region of southeastern British Columbia, in the Rocky Mountain Trench south of Kimberley. It is the region’s main retail, health, and transport hub, with airport links and highway corridors toward Alberta and the U.S. border. Surrounding peaks frame a compact urban core. About 20,000 people live in Cranbrook.
